The '''Geode''' is a [[Minerals|Mineral]] deposit that contains [[minerals]], [[artifacts]], ores, or basic [[:Category:Resources|resources]]. It can be obtained from breaking rocks above ground in Stardew Valley and in [[the Mines]] (especially floors 1-39), or dropped by [[Duggy|Duggies]]. It may also be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the [[Museum]] or received as a gift at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. A [[Stonefish]] [[Fish Pond]] may produce 1 or 5 Geodes when its population reaches 9. Geodes can also be obtained by pickaxing [[Mining#Geode Node|Geode Nodes]]. 2-4 Geodes may occasionally be found in [[Supply Crate]]s on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] if the player has not upgraded the [[Farmhouse]] yet. Geodes cannot be obtained from breaking rocks on Spring 1 of Year 1.<ref name="newgame" /> 

The geode can be broken open by [[Clint]] in the [[Blacksmith|Blacksmith shop]] for {{Price|25}} or by using a [[Geode Crusher]].

Neither daily [[luck]] nor luck [[buffs]] affect the contents of a Geode.

===Resources===
Note that obtaining Iron Ore from a Geode is only possible after reaching level 26 of [[The Mines]]. Before reaching level 26, a geode that would give iron ore will instead give copper ore. Except for clay and stone, the following items will be obtained in the following amounts: 30% for 1, 30% for 3, 30% for 5, 9% for 10, and 1% for 20. Stone has a 50% chance to use those values and a 50% chance to give only 1. Only 1 clay can be obtained from a single geode.

==Tailoring==
Geode is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Gray Hoodie]]. [[File:Shirt160.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
*Two Geodes may be requested by [[Sunfish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 3 to 5.
*Five Geodes may be requested by [[Stonefish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.
*Eight Geodes may be requested by the Raccoon at the [[Giant Stump]] as part of his fifth request, or as part of any request starting with the sixth.
